Game Overview

Ladder Race is a arcade title where dash through an imaginative stickman world in Ladder Race. Build and climb ladders to conquer obstacles, requiring strategic timing and quick maneuvers. With simple tap controls, race against opponents and test your speed and problem-solving skills in this exhilarating, obstacle-filled arcade adventure. Can you climb to victory?

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Ladder Race is easy to pick up. Dash through an imaginative stickman world in Ladder Race!
